item.name: Handwashing_Station
item.description: Camp handwashing station with potable water, soap, disposable towels, and a basin that contains the wastewater.
item.readyBeforeUse: Water, soap, and disposable towels are available. The wastewater basin has capacity and does not leak.
item.readyForNextPerson: Water, soap, and disposable towels remain available. No water has reached the playa.
item.ifNotReady: Stop using the station and tell the Dominatrix.
